name: Deterministic PRNG & Daily Challenge Global Sync
note: The daily puzzle has to be the same puzzle for every player on Earth on that date. Determinism is the whole feature, not an implementation detail.

mutations.name: the daily puzzle stops being the same for everyone
mutations.why: If the seed picks up anything but the date, two players compare times on two different puzzles and the leaderboard means nothing.

mutations.name: the day's puzzle ignores the kind
mutations.why: KP-4. A killer daily that is the day's standard puzzle has no cages; one built without the date as its seed would differ between players.
mutations.expectFailure: The killer daily is a killer
